ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory, automated, and documented screening of all shareholders, UBOs, officers, and material counterparties against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council sanctions implemented through EU Council Regulations including Regulations (EU) No 269/2010 and No 765/2006, the OFAC SDN List for USD payment rails, FATF public statements, and Luxembourg FIU (CRF) advisories. Enhanced due diligence applies to resident and foreign PEPs, their family members, and close associates under the AML Law as amended, with mandatory source-of-wealth verification, senior management approval, and continuous monitoring throughout the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) — Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); portal www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Articles of association and corporate deeds are executed in French, German, or Luxembourgish; company names may be in French, German, Luxembourgish, English, or another language but must be transcribed in Latin script. The name must be distinctive within the RCS, not identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name, not contrary to public order or good morals, and must include the legal-form suffix 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or 'SARL'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the notary or applicant obtains the written RCS refusal grounds, rectifies the proposed name, and re-submits through the LBR filing interface within the remaining reservation window. If the refusal persists, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the RCS supervisory authority and thereafter bring summary proceedings (référé) or a substantive claim before the Commercial Chamber of the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg), with a further appeal to the Court of Appeal (Cour d'appel) within two months of the judgment. In practice, an advance informal name-check submission to the RCS and amendment of the corporate name by notarial deed resolves the large majority of rejections without litigation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A fully virtual or mailbox-type office is not permissible for a trading SARL: the Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies, as amended, and Luxembourg tax substance doctrine require a genuine registered office (siège social) and an effective management seat in Luxembourg with local premises, books, and decision-making. A licensed domiciliation agent may provide physical accommodation and administrative services, but the company must maintain substantive presence in Luxembourg for corporate, VAT, and CIT purposes; reliance on a virtual address materially increases bank-refusal risk for SWIFT LC and TT wire trade finance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the RCS/LBR, labor inspectorate (ITM), or direct-tax authorities (ACD) for a compliant standard-risk trading SARL; probability rises above 30% where a virtual office, shared mailbox, or bulk single-service-provider domiciliation arrangement is used.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended, Title V regarding the Société à Responsabilité Limitée (Articles 710-1 to 710-37), together with the Law of 19 December 2002 on the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) and the Law decorating the electronic compendium of companies and associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), located at 8-10, rue Léon Laval, L-3372 Leudelange, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, accessible via the e-filing portal www.lbr.lu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte de constitution (Deed of Incorporation) comprising the Charte constitutive and Articles of Association, executed either as a notarial deed before a Luxembourg notary or, where legally permitted, as a private instrument (acte sous seing privé) signed by all incorporators, and filed in full with the RCS.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum share capital of EUR 12,000. At least 25% of each cash-subscribed share must be paid up at subscription and deposited in a non-interest-bearing blocked bank account ('attestation de blocage') opened in the company's name; the blocked funds are released only upon presentation of the RCS registration certificate. Contributions in kind must be fully paid up and supported by the statutory auditor's report where required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the undersigned shareholders, subscribing to the entire issued share capital of the Société à Responsabilité Limitée, approve the deed of incorporation and the articles of association in their final form. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office is fixed at the address set out in the articles, in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed sole manager (Gérant), with full powers to represent the company and to execute all acts falling within the corporate purpose. RESOLVED FINALLY, that the manager is authorised to file the incorporation file with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register, to release the blocked capital upon registration, and to complete all tax, social security and banking formalities. Adopted unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration checks, corporate name reservation and blocked capital account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) online name-search and a Luxembourg or EU credit institution for the blocked deposit account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a preliminary availability search on the RCS portal to obtain a negative clearance for the proposed corporate name and to confirm absence of confusing similarity with existing registered names. Simultaneously open a non-interest-bearing blocked account in the name of the company-in-formation, pay in cash subscription of at least 25% of the EUR 12,000 minimum capital, and obtain the bank's blockage certificate (attestation de blocage) addressed to the future company.
required_dossiers: Company name availability certificate (RCS search result)
Draft of the articles of association
Bank blockage certificate confirming deposit of the paid-up capital
Passport copies of the proposed shareholders and manager
Power of attorney if a legal counsel or formation agent acts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to conflict with a prior registration, submit two alternate proposed names and proceed with first available; if the bank queries KYC documentation, correct the dossier and revert within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the deed of incorporation before a Luxembourg notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary public in the district of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary reviews the final articles, the schedule of cash subscriptions, the bank blockage certificate and the identity documents of the incorporators and of the first manager. All incorporators and the first manager must appear before the notary and sign the deed of incorporation; the deed must contain the corporate name, the registered office, the corporate object, the share capital subscription, the appointment of the manager and the declaration of compliance with the Law of 10 August 1915.
required_dossiers: Final draft of the deed of incorporation and articles
Bank blockage certificate
Original identity documents of shareholders and manager
Evidence of registered office address or mailbox contract
Declaration of good standing and criminal record extract of the manager where requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a legal defect, amend the articles to cure the deficiency (e.g., narrow the corporate object to comply with public policy) and reschedule execution; an incorrectly executed deed may be re-executed by the same notary without additional state filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing and registration with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) e-filing window at www.lbr.lu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed deed of incorporation, the articles, the appointment and acceptance of the manager, proof of registered office and the bank blockage certificate through the RCS secure portal within one month of execution. Pay the electronic filing fee and await the registrar's legal examination; upon approval the company is attributed its registration number (matricule) and receives the certificate of registration.
required_dossiers: Signed deed of incorporation and articles
Consent and appointment of the manager (Gérant)
Proof of availability of the registered office
Bank blockage certificate
Residence permits and police record extracts of the signatories if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query, respond through the notary or counsel within the prescribed period (usually one to two months), supply the requested clarifications on the corporate object, capital or powers, and resubmit the deficient documents; an erroneous refusal may be challenged before the District Court of Luxembourg.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the official electronic compendium of companies and associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) — RESA publication service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following registration, the RCS automatically transmits the constituent deed and registration particulars to the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA) for official publication; the companies acquire good faith protection as to the published content. Review the published extract promptly for accuracy of the corporate name, object, share capital and manager details.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate
Deed of incorporation and articles as filed
Registration particulars extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the published extract contains material errors, instruct the notary to execute a corrective deed (acte rectificatif) and apply to the RCS for a corrected publication; the corrected publication is effective towards third parties from the date of publication.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration tax, social security and business establishment formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'Enregistrement, des Domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS); Ministry of the Economy — Direction générale des classes moyennes
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with the AEDT for corporate income tax, municipal business tax and VAT and obtain the Luxembourg VAT number; register as employer with the CCSS within eight days of making any hire; apply for the establishment permit (autorisation d'établissement) for the wholesale merchant activity, appending the manager's qualifications and good conduct evidence; present the RCS certificate at the bank to release the blocked capital and open the active commercial bank account.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate
VAT and tax registration application filed with the AEDT
Employer registration declaration to the CCSS
Establishment permit application form with professional qualification diplomas and criminal record extracts
Bank account opening forms and blocked fund release instruction
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the establishment permit is refused, administrative appeal may be lodged within 40 days before the Administrative Tribunal of Luxembourg; if the tax authorities challenge the registered office or legal form, file the corrected documents through MyGuichet and re-submit within the statutory time limit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie — Direction générale des classes moyennes et de l'entrepreneuriat; for food safety controls, the Administration vétérinaire under the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Viticulture
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement (establishment permit) issued under the amended Law of 2 September 2011 regulating access to the professions of craftsman, merchant, industrialist and certain liberal professions; the wholesale trade in dehydrated vegetables and spices is classified as a merchant activity requiring this permit where operational presence in Luxembourg is established.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement — Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the trading and dry warehousing of dehydrated vegetables and spices is not listed in Annexes I or II of the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 15 May 2018 implementing the Law of 15 May 2018 on environmental impact assessment; no full EIA report is required for the contemplated activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No significant industrial wastewater or VOC emissions are generated; sanitary wastewater must comply with the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 9 January 2007 on release of urban wastewater into municipal sewerage; storage hygiene and food contact materials must comply with Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 and Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004; waste disposal must be contracted to authorised collectors under the Law of 21 March 2012 on waste management; pesticide residues in imported spices must respect the maximum residue limits of Regulation (EC) No 396/2005.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the Luxembourg fire and rescue inspection authority covering emergency exits, extinguishers and smoke detection for the dry storage warehouse; structural load inspection certificate for racking and pallet systems prepared by a registered structural engineer; workplace clearance from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) verifying electrical safety, ventilation and occupational health for the packing and warehouse areas.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direct taxes: Administration des contributions directes (ACD), Luxembourg City; VAT and registration duties: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT). Unified administrative and filing portal: MyGuichet.lu (Single Point of Contact), with e-filing through eCDF (corporate income tax) and e-TVA (VAT returns and EC Sales Lists).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: STEP 1: Constitution of the SARL before a Luxembourg notary and registration of the corporate file with the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR/RCS) through the Guichet unique on MyGuichet.lu. STEP 2: RCS registration automatically attributes the 13-digit business identification number (numéro d'identification) and triggers simultaneous enrolment with the CCSS (social security), the ACD (corporate income tax and communal business tax files) and the AEDT (VAT file). STEP 3: Submit VAT registration application Form 640 (Formulaire 640) to the AEDT; non-established non-EU entities must instead file Form 641 and appoint an AEDT-approved Luxembourg VAT fiscal representative to obtain the LU VAT identification number (LU + 8 digits), while non-established EU entities register directly or via the OSS without a taxable representative. STEP 4: Acquire LuxTrust digital certificates for the managers and activate the e-TVA and eCDF filing channels. TIMELINE: RCS registration consent is granted within 1-5 business days after notarisation; AEDT VAT ID is issued within 5-10 business days after Form 640; the ACD tax file and matricule are issued in parallel. No separate statutory licence is required for wholesale dehydrated vegetable and spice trading under ISIC 4638.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (resident SARL: full Luxembourg corporate income tax on worldwide income; combined headline burden in Luxembourg City of 24.94% for fiscal year 2024, comprising 17% CIT, 7% solidarity surcharge and 6.75% communal business tax; no tax-exempt or free-zone status; territorial carve-outs apply only to income from foreign permanent establishments and foreign immovable property, exempt or credit-relieved under tax treaties).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg does not operate a US-style check-the-box or entity classification election. Relevant statutory elections available to the trading SARL: (i) participation exemption election for qualifying dividends and capital gains (10% or EUR 1.2 million acquisition-cost threshold, continuous 12-month holding period, corporate income tax-subject subsidiary); (ii) IP regime election granting an 80% exemption of qualifying IP-derived income under the modified nexus approach; (iii) VAT grouping election under Article 61 of the VAT law, combining the SARL with financially, economically and organisationally linked Luxembourg entities into a single taxable person ('assujetti unique'); (iv) election for joint and several VAT liability on commissionaire arrangements; (v) option to file VAT returns quarterly instead of monthly where annual turnover is below EUR 2 million; (vi) hybrid mismatch alignment elections under the Law of 20 December 2019 (ATAD I/II) to neutralise double non-taxation. The SARL is opaque and separately taxable; no pass-through or transparency election exists.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), acting within the Eurosystem and the European System of Central Banks; no separate Foreign Exchange Administration exists in Luxembourg, as exchange-control functions (statistical monitoring, external sector data, sanctions screening coordination and TARGET2 oversight) are absorbed by the BCL, the Ministry of Finance, and the CSSF for credit institution conduct.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is freely convertible for both current and capital transactions in Luxembourg; the jurisdiction does not operate exchange controls, dual exchange rates or conversion licences and applies Article 63 TFEU plus the OECD Code of Liberalisation of Capital Movements. Profit remittance by the SARL to non-resident shareholders is lawful without prior ministerial approval, subject to corporate law conditions (distributable reserves confirmed by audited annual accounts, board resolution) and to a nominal 15% withholding tax which can be reduced under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive or an applicable double-tax treaty. The only non-FX hurdles for remittances are banking AML/KYC source-of-funds checks, BCL balance-of-payments statistical declarations for flows in excess of the prevailing materiality threshold (approximately EUR 12,500 per counterparty per annum), and compliance with EU financial sanctions. USD or CNY receipts can be retained, assigned or converted at market price without quantitative limits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender, forced conversion or repatriation timeline applies to Luxembourg resident exporters; proceeds may remain in USD/CNY accounts indefinitely. The SARL's only implementation duties are (i) respecting BCL balance-of-payments reporting on cumulative export receipts with a given non-resident counterparty above the reporting threshold (about EUR 12,500 per counterparty per year, as per BCL external statistics instructions), (ii) keeping complete transaction documentary evidence to ensure inward receipts are classified as exports of goods rather than equity-like or undefined inflows, and (iii) ensuring all invoices and LC presentations are consistent with the commercial reality of the dehydrated vegetables and spices transaction. Conversion of EUR, USD and CNY is free but will be priced and executed per the bank's spot books without regulatory constraint.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as primary treasury rail, MODERATE only for low-value operational automation. A CSSF-licensed or EU/EEA-passported EMI may provide euro-denominated payment accounts, SEPA credit transfer initiation and KYC APIs for a Luxembourg SARL without requiring a full banking relationship; however, it cannot operate the notarial capital-blocage attestation required for incorporation, cannot issue documentary letters of credit or bank guarantees, cannot provide SWIFT MT103/CHIPS/Fedwire correspondent clearing equivalent, and cannot support a Luxembourg-law ISDA hedging framework. Non-EEA offshore EMIs have NO legal viability: they do not benefit from PSD2 passporting, would expose the SARL and its account bank to licensing and AML infringements, and cannot clear through TARGET2 or SEPA; use of such entities must be limited strictly to non-treasury, non-documentary pilot payments with fully screened counterparties.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is de facto mandatory for at least one Luxembourg-resident principal or authorised signatory during final onboarding: the notarised board and shareholder resolutions for account opening, signatory mandates and AML/KYC declarations (Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, CSSF Regulation 12-02) normally require original signatures and identity verification, and the CSSF's digital onboarding guidance still permits pure remote opening only for EU residents with eIDAS-compliant eID or for low-risk structures without non-EU UBOs. For this SARL, the opening of the capital escrow account must be completed either in person at the bank's Luxembourg branch, with the manager presenting original passports and a recent RCS extract, or via a Luxembourg-regulated notary using e-notary procedures combined with apostilled and legalised foreign corporate documents. Remote video-KYC may be accepted for operational accounts after first physical contact, provided the UBO structure is transparent, no politically exposed persons are detected, and the bank's compliance committee approves the exception.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque or undocumented non-resident ownership chain, including non-EU parent entities not reflected in the Luxembourg RBE beneficial-ownership register, nominee layers, or fiduciary structures preventing identification of natural-person UBOs.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RCS extract certified within 3 months; articles of association notarially certified; complete ownership chain from natural persons through the SARL; proof of filing in the Luxembourg registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE); signed and dated UBO declaration; passport copies of all UBOs with apostille or consular legalisation; professional reference from the SARL's Luxembourg réviseur d'entreprises.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and geopolitical screening flags raised by the bank's filtering engine against trade counterparties, freight forwarders or settlement banks in the dehydrated-spice supply chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cleared EU consolidated sanctions screening printout (EU Regulation 833/2014 and implementing acts) together with OFAC and UN screening results; entity LEI and ELF codes of counterparties; compliance opinion letter of Luxembourg bar-admitted counsel; contractual clauses certifying no sanctions nexus and end-user declaration; supplier enhanced due diligence questionnaire covering ownership, banking references and customs history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Geographic and trade-route inconsistency, given a Luxembourg-resident SARL sourcing predominantly from China, India, Egypt or Southeast Asia, presenting trade-based money laundering risks such as phantom shipments, double invoicing or over/under-invoicing of dehydrated vegetables and spices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete transaction lifecycle file comprising purchase order, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or airway bill, container tracking report, marine cargo insurance certificate, phytosanitary and SPS health certificate, certificate of origin, and independent third-party pre-shipment inspection report from SGS, Bureau Veritas or Inspectorate; commodity price benchmarks from UN Comtrade or Mintec to evidence arm's-length valuation; stock records and annual audited financial statements of the SARL.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Velocity or funding anomaly, such as rapid disbursement of freshly capitalised balances, mixing of personal and business funds in one account, or unexplained cash-out chains via FX conversion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury business plan and 12-month cash-flow forecast; signed procurement contracts and LC drafts; invoices matched to an approved supplier list; bank statement reconciliation; source-of-funds declaration signed by the shareholder and certified by a Luxembourg notary; monthly management accounts and VAT or customs declarations filed with the Administration de l'enregistrement; corporate authorisation matrix for all signatories.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Protocol for subscriber capital and shareholder loans: the remitter must be the exact legal shareholder named in the SARL deed and RBE; an MT103 wire is sent to the bank account opened in the SARL's name, using tag 70 to state clearly 'Capital subscription - [SARL name] - incorporation' or, for loans, 'Shareholder loan - [date]', accompanied by the BCL statistical classification for direct-investment equity (FDI equity capital) rather than a generic or ambiguous code. The Luxembourg receiving bank credits a blocked capital account and delivers an attestation de blocage to the notary, which is mandatory evidence for signing the incorporation deed and filing with the RCS; if the injection is in USD or another foreign currency, the bank may spot-convert to EUR and must evidence the conversion rate applied; funds are released only after RCS registration. EUR clearing uses TARGET2, USD clearing uses the CHIPS/Fedwire network through the Luxembourg bank's US correspondent; signatories must provide source-of-funds declarations and the bank-completed UBO/PEP interview, and all cross-border movements are captured automatically in BCL balance-of-payments statistics.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier and logistics payments are executed principally by direct SWIFT MT103 transfers for TT settlement and by irrevocable commercial letters of credit issued under ICC UCP 600 for significant Chinese, Indian, Egyptian or Spanish purchases, covering presentation of commercial invoice, bill of lading, phytosanitary certificate, certificate of origin and independent inspection certificate; standby letters of credit under URDG 758 may secure performance obligations. EUR payment legs settle via SEPA credit transfers (ISO 20022 pain.001) and TARGET2; USD legs clear via CHIPS or Fedwire through the Luxembourg account bank's USD correspondent. Every disbursement must carry the appropriate BCL balance-of-payments classification for imports of goods, must be reconciled with underlying contracts and customs declarations, and must pass EU and OFAC sanctions screening before release; documentary collections on a DP/DA basis may be used for smaller quantities and established counterparties.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD forward contracts documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement and Credit Support Annex, used to lock settlement margins on export receipts and import procurement without speculative intent.
Foreign exchange swaps employed intra-company to bridge short-term USD liquidity against EUR treasury and to roll forward open positions without affecting the company's long-term FX risk profile.
Cross-currency swaps (XCCY) for medium-term alignment of USD disbursement legs with EUR receipt flows, subject to ISDA documentation and EMIR margin and clearing obligations.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in restricted, non-convertible or high-volatility currencies such as offshore CNY, INR or EGP, permitted under EU law for hedging demonstrable physical import and export exposures and strictly disallowed for speculative flows.

Vanilla purchased currency options to protect trade tender margins, subject to EMIR transaction reporting and prohibited under the SARL treasury policy when used for leveraged or speculative optionality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual inventory, year-end closing and drafting of statutory annual accounts (comptes annuels) under Luxembourg GAAP by the gérants
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal statutory corporate act; reviewed at the annual shareholders' meeting prior to filing with the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR/RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Completed at financial year-end (standard calendar year: 31 December) and presented to shareholders within 6 months thereafter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Defective or missing accounts block lawful dividend distributions and discharge (quitus) of the gérants; gross negligence exposes the gérants to civil liability and criminal sanctions under the Law of 10 August 1915

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary annual general meeting to approve annual accounts, decide dividend distributions and grant discharge to the gérants
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate act recorded in the Minute Book; no separate regulator filing required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year and within 6 months of financial year-end (calendar-year SARL: no later than 30 June)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene prevents formal approval of accounts and discharge; any shareholder may request a court-ordered shareholders' meeting (with coercive fines)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of approved annual accounts (balance sheet, profit-and-loss account, notes, and statutory auditor's report where applicable) and publication in the RESA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) / Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after financial year-end (calendar-year SARL: by 31 July) and within 1 month of AGM approval if earlier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Upon Public Prosecutor's notice, non-compliance within one month leads to a criminal fine and judicial enforcement before the commercial court; persistent default can trigger forced strike-off (radiation) of the SARL from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) data in the Register of Beneficial Owners
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE), operated electronically by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) under the Ministry of Justice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within one month of the anniversary of the SARL's RCS registration; any change must be declared within one month of the triggering shareholding event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fines from EUR 150 up to EUR 750,000 for the entity and up to EUR 250,000 for gérants; incorrect or stale RBE data also impairs AML/KYC acceptance by banks and business partners

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax (CIT), municipal business tax (ICC) and net wealth tax (IFT) return with supporting Luxembourg GAAP accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD), Luxembourg Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within 6 months after the end of the tax year (calendar-year SARL: by 30 June; ACD e-filing practice may grant extension to 31 July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 10% penalty surcharge and monthly late-payment interest at 0.6% per month; continued default leads to ex officio assessment and possible criminal sanctions against the gérants

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of an approved statutory auditor (réviseur d'entreprises agréé) if the SARL exceeds at least two of the three thresholds: balance-sheet total > EUR 4.4 million; net turnover > EUR 8.8 million; average workforce > 50 employees. Audit may also be triggered by qualified minority shareholders holding at least 10% of the share capital.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, the Law of 19 December 2002 and the Law of 10 August 2016 (transposing Directive 2013/34/EU); IFRS as adopted by the EU is available for consolidated accounts, while individual statutory accounts of a SARL are prepared under Luxembourg GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL must confirm its RBE beneficial ownership record annually through the LBR electronic portal regardless of whether ownership has changed, and must file any update within one month of a share transfer or change in beneficial owner. The RBE confirmation is independent of the RCS filing and must reflect the updated Register of Members.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 850 - USD 3,200 per year for a regulated domiciliation/registered-agent package including official mail handling and company secretarial support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,500 - USD 16,500 per year for a standalone small/medium SARL trading entity; consolidated or group audits typically exceed USD 20,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (combined: 17% IRC + 7% solidarity surcharge + municipal business tax ~6.75%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IP box regime (80% exemption on qualifying IP income), investment tax credit, participation exemption for dividends and capital gains, and other targeted incentives. For a trading entity, standard rates apply.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1000 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically via MyGuichet.lu
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due by 31 May of the year following the fiscal year-end; extensions may be granted upon request.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income (net profit before tax adjustments)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report Luxembourg-source income only; apply DTA provisions if applicable.
Add back any non-deductible items per Luxembourg tax law.
Claim only if conditions under the participation exemption are met.
Offset against current year profits; subject to ownership change restrictions.
Compute the final taxable amount for corporate income tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of EUR 100 to EUR 1,000 per month, plus interest at 0.6% per month on unpaid tax. Additional penalties for gross negligence or fraud.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% (reduced to 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive if holding ≥10% for 12 months)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim reduced withholding tax under a DTA, submit Form 1000 (or specific application) to the Luxembourg tax authorities, provide a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the recipient's jurisdiction, and ensure the beneficial ownership test is met. The application must be filed before the dividend distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 25% statutory, reduced to 0% under EU Interest and Royalties Directive if conditions met; Interest: 25% statutory, reduced to 0% under EU Interest and Royalties Directive or DTA.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required if related-party transactions exceed EUR 1 million; Master File required if group consolidated turnover exceeds EUR 50 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg applies Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) for certain activities (e.g., IP, financing). For a trading company, adequate substance (physical office, qualified staff, decision-making in Luxembourg) is required to avoid being classified as a shell company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate underreporting of income or overstating deductions in the corporate tax return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to EUR 250,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; additional tax penalties of 10% to 50% of the evaded tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for unpaid taxes if they knowingly participated in evasion; travel bans and asset freezes may be imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a letterbox company without real business activity, employees, or premises in Luxembourg.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of tax benefits, reclassification of income, and potential administrative fines up to EUR 250,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held liable for unpaid taxes and penalties if they fail to ensure substance; potential criminal charges for fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement adequate anti-money laundering procedures, including customer due diligence and record-keeping.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to EUR 1 million for serious breaches; suspension of business license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can face personal fines and imprisonment up to 5 years for willful AML violations; travel bans may be issued.
